autonomous_wave.goal: Extend fail-closed managed-path validation to auxiliary IO ownership/publication/export-batch authorities and close the dangling-symlink ambiguity without changing HQ-owned contracts.
autonomous_wave.rationale: AW47 secured the primary file-store boundary but explicitly left nested recovery metadata and batch directories outside its claim. Those paths carry cleanup/publication authority, and FileManager.fileExists also misclassifies dangling symlinks as absent, making this a direct portable data-safety gap.
autonomous_wave.done_when: Auxiliary ownership/publication/batch roots and leaves cannot redirect writes, reads or cleanup through symlinks; dangling symlinks cannot masquerade as missing future paths; focused strict-concurrency typechecks and real-filesystem negative/normal self-check pass after any discovered defects are repaired; bounded portable benchmark and regression XCTest source are committed; Evidence/status are durable; residual syscall TOCTOU and Apple/device gates remain explicit; no PARITY claim is made.
autonomous_wave.next_priority: Re-audit remaining Lane-2 portable durability/security gaps after AW48; prioritize a concrete Library-side filesystem authority or durable lifecycle correctness gap that can be completed without Apple-only evidence, while leaving descriptor-level TOCTOU and physical-device gates explicit if they cannot be solved portably without disproportionate complexity.
